title: What We Do — ArmaturaSec d.o.o.
text:
ArmaturaSec builds network security appliances for operational technology environments. If you run a water treatment plant, an electricity distribution substation, or a manufacturing line and you need to control who can talk to your PLCs and whether that traffic looks legitimate, that is what our products are designed for.

We are not a general-purpose cybersecurity company. We do not sell endpoint agents, email filters, or cloud security platforms. Every product we have shipped since 2008 has been a hardware device that sits inside an industrial network and inspects or controls traffic at the protocol level.

Our NetGuard-OT appliance handles network access control: it enforces rules about which devices can communicate, blocks unauthorised connections, and logs everything in a format that your existing SCADA historian can ingest. The Mini variant fits on a standard DIN rail for installations where cabinet space is limited.

ProtoSense is our protocol inspection module. It understands Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP at the message level, not just the packet level, so it can tell you that a device sent a write command to a coil it has never written to before — not just that traffic occurred.

Our SecAudit service is a one-time on-site engagement. Two of our engineers spend two days on your site, map the network as it actually exists, identify the gaps between that and how it is supposed to be configured, and produce a written report with prioritised findings.

We work with clients in Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, and Montenegro. Most of our installations are in the energy and water sectors. A growing share are in food and beverage manufacturing.

If you want to talk about a specific installation or you have a question about whether our products fit your environment, contact our sales team in Zrenjanin.

title: Firmware Engineer — Network Protocols (Zrenjanin)
text:
ArmaturaSec is looking for a firmware engineer to join our core development team in Zrenjanin. We have a monthly release cycle across four hardware variants and we need someone who can contribute to protocol parsing, system integration, and the tooling that keeps the whole process running.

What the work looks like day to day: you will work on the firmware that runs on our NetGuard-OT appliances — mostly C with an increasing share of Rust for new components. You will work closely with the person responsible for our Yocto build system and with the QA team that tests each release on physical hardware.

We deal with Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP, and a few less common industrial protocols. You do not need to know all of them when you start. You do need to be comfortable reading protocol specifications and writing parsers from them.

The hardware side: our appliances are based on ARM Cortex-A SoCs. We have a bench in the office with physical boards, PLC simulators, and packet generators. You will spend time at that bench.

What we are looking for:
— At least three years writing firmware or embedded systems software in C
— Comfort with Linux networking internals (netfilter, raw sockets, that level)
— Experience debugging with JTAG or serial console, not just printf
— Some exposure to Rust is useful but not required

What we are not looking for: someone who wants to work on cloud infrastructure or web services. This is hardware-close work.

We offer a permanent contract, a salary in line with the Zrenjanin market for this experience level, and flexible hours within reason. The office is in the industrial zone on the north side of the city. Remote work is possible one or two days a week once you are settled in.

Send a CV and a short note about something you have built to posao@armaturesec.rs.

title: QA and Test Automation Engineer (Zrenjanin)
text:
Our QA team maintains a regression suite of around 1,400 test cases that runs against every firmware release on four hardware boards. The suite is written in Python and runs against physical hardware on a test bench. It works, but it is slow to extend and we are spending too much engineering time on it.

We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of that suite and make it better. That means maintaining what is already there, finding ways to generate or scaffold new test cases faster, and reducing the manual effort involved in keeping tests up to date when firmware behaviour changes.

This is not a role where you will be asked to deploy a commercial test management platform and declare victory. We have specific constraints: the test runner is Python, the hardware is physical and will stay physical, and the timeline for releases is not going to change. What we need is someone who will sit with the existing code, understand why it is the way it is, and improve it incrementally.

Some things that would be useful background:
— Experience maintaining a large test suite in Python
— Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop testing or any kind of test automation that involves real devices rather than simulators
— An opinion about why test suites grow brittle over time and what to do about it

Experience with industrial protocols is not required. You will learn what you need to know about Modbus and BACnet on the job.

The role is full-time in Zrenjanin. One or two days remote per week is possible. We expect some collaboration with our firmware engineers and some with the field support team who often find bugs first.

Questions and applications to posao@armaturesec.rs. We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: ArmaturaSec Completes Installation at Heating Utility in North Macedonia
text:
ArmaturaSec has completed the installation of NetGuard-OT appliances at three control network sites operated by a district heating utility in North Macedonia. The project began in October 2023 following a SecAudit engagement that identified uncontrolled lateral movement between the utility's corporate network and its SCADA segment.

The installation covers the main heat production facility and two distribution pump stations. Each site received a NetGuard-OT unit configured to enforce communication rules between engineering workstations, RTUs, and the SCADA server. ProtoSense modules were added at the main facility to provide visibility into Modbus TCP traffic on the primary production loop.

Miloš Anđić, who led the installation from our side, noted that the network topology at the pump stations differed significantly from the documentation provided before the site visit. 'We found three devices that were not on any diagram. Two were legacy HMI panels that had been connected years earlier and forgotten. One we could not identify at all. That kind of discovery is exactly why we do a physical walkthrough before we start configuring anything.'

The utility's IT manager confirmed that the project came in on the agreed timeline despite the additional scoping work required during installation.

This is our sixth active installation in North Macedonia. We are currently in early discussions with two other utilities in the region about similar projects.

For questions about projects in North Macedonia or other markets outside Serbia, contact our sales team at prodaja@armaturesec.rs.

title: Why We Stopped Trying to Use Public ICS Datasets for Anomaly Detection
text:
For about eighteen months we tried to build a detection component that could identify unusual Modbus traffic by training on labelled datasets published by research groups. We had four datasets we thought were credible. We spent a significant chunk of time getting them into a format our pipeline could use, training classifiers, and then testing them against real traffic from our own lab bench and from anonymised captures our clients had agreed to share with us.

The results were not good. False positive rates that looked acceptable on the test set turned into something much worse when we applied the model to a real site. A water treatment plant runs its Modbus polling on a rhythm that is specific to that plant — the scan rate, the register addresses, the devices on the bus, everything. A model trained on traffic from a research testbed in another country does not know that rhythm. It cannot know it.

We also noticed that the labelled datasets we were using represented attack scenarios that were either very obvious (flooding the bus with write commands) or very specific to hardware we do not see in the Balkans. Neither is particularly useful.

What we think actually works for our environment is learning what normal looks like on a specific site and flagging deviations from that. No labels, no pre-trained model from somewhere else. This is not a new idea. The challenge is doing it in a way that runs on our hardware, produces alerts that a plant operator can understand without a data science background, and does not require us to collect six months of clean traffic before it is useful.

We have not solved this yet. We have a set of traffic archives from our client base and one engineer who has been working on this part-time. If you have relevant experience or want to talk about it, we are interested.

title: What PravniPilot Does — Platform and Services Overview
text:
PravniPilot gives lawyers faster access to the decisions and arguments that matter to their case.

Our platform holds over two million court decisions from Serbia, Croatia and Bosnia-Herzegovina. Every document is parsed, indexed and linked to related cases so you can find relevant precedent in seconds rather than hours. Keyword search, Boolean filters, court-level filters and date ranges are all available from a single interface. No installation required — the platform runs in any modern browser.

The case-outcome prediction module analyzes the facts you enter and compares them against historical decisions in the same legal area. It returns a probability distribution across outcome categories, along with the decisions that influenced that estimate. The module currently covers commercial disputes, labor claims and property litigation. Prediction results include the number of supporting cases so you know how much data sits behind any estimate.

For firms that process high volumes of documents, our document annotation tool generates structured summaries of uploaded filings, extracts cited statutes and precedents, and flags arguments the opposing side has used in similar past cases.

Enterprise customers — insurers, banks and larger litigation practices — can access our full dataset through a bulk-export API. We also license cleaned, structured legal datasets to third parties under a separate data agreement.

All customer data is stored on our own infrastructure inside Serbia. We do not use customer documents or queries to train or update our models without explicit written consent.

For pricing, onboarding timelines or a demonstration, contact our sales team in Subotica or visit our development office at NTP Novi Sad.

text:

What the work involves:

— Experience fine-tuning transformer models; familiarity with low-resource language settings is a plus

What we offer:

— Access to a genuinely interesting and under-explored dataset

Send a CV and a short note about a model you have trained to posao@pravnipilot.rs. No recruiters.

title: Advokatska kancelarija Mišković & Todić signs three-year enterprise agreement
text:
PravniPilot has signed a three-year enterprise agreement with Advokatska kancelarija Mišković & Todić, a Belgrade-based litigation firm with 34 attorneys focused on commercial and construction disputes.

Mišković & Todić will use the full PravniPilot platform, including the bulk data API, across all practice groups. The agreement also includes access to our structured dataset of Serbian commercial court decisions under the data licensing program.

Dragan Todić, managing partner, said the firm evaluated three legal research tools over six months before making a decision. The primary factor was the depth of the Serbian court archive and the ability to filter decisions by specific court chambers, which none of the international tools offered for domestic case law.

For PravniPilot, the agreement is the largest single contract signed since the company's founding. It also represents the first time a customer has formally committed to using both the research platform and the data licensing product together.

Our head of enterprise sales, Milena Vukić, noted that several other mid-size litigation firms in Belgrade and Novi Sad have requested demonstrations following the announcement, and that Q1 pipeline activity is the strongest the company has seen in three years.

The agreement takes effect on 1 March 2024. Onboarding for the Mišković & Todić team begins the same week at their Belgrade office, led by our customer success team from Subotica.

title: Why our AI summaries cited a case that no longer applies — and what we are doing about it
text:
We want to be straightforward about something that happened twice in the past eight months.

Our platform generated research summaries that cited precedents which had been amended or effectively overturned by subsequent rulings. In both cases, a law firm user included the summary language in a draft brief. In one case the error was caught internally before filing. In the other, the brief went to opposing counsel with the outdated citation. No proceeding was harmed, but the firm was embarrassed and we were responsible.

We have spent time since the second incident understanding why this happened and what a real fix looks like.

The short version: our summarization model generates fluent text, but it does not inherently know whether the case it is citing is still good law. It picks the most statistically relevant decision for a given query, not the most current or most authoritative one. We have a recency filter in the search layer, but that filter does not feed back into the summary generation in a meaningful way. The result is a system that sounds confident and is sometimes wrong.

What we are doing now: we have added a visible warning banner on all AI-generated summaries that explicitly tells users to verify every cited decision before using it in a filing. That is not a technical fix — it is a patch. The real work is building sentence-level source provenance so that every claim in a summary links to a specific, datestamped decision and shows the user how many cases support that claim. We are actively working on this and will say more when we have something worth showing.

We are also reviewing whether our onboarding materials have been clear enough about the limitations of the summarization tool. Based on what we saw this year, they were not.

We think lawyers deserve tools that are honest about what they know and what they do not. We are not there yet on this feature, but we are working on it.

title: Database Engineer — Search Infrastructure
text:
We are looking for a database engineer who has dealt with large-scale search infrastructure and is not afraid to recommend tearing something down and rebuilding it when the situation calls for it.

Context: Our Elasticsearch cluster indexes over two million legal documents across three languages. Search response times have degraded significantly as the corpus grew, and we need someone who can diagnose the architecture, propose a credible path forward and help us execute it without unacceptable downtime.

Day-to-day responsibilities:
— Profiling query performance and identifying bottlenecks in our current Elasticsearch setup
— Designing and prototyping an improved indexing architecture, which may or may not remain Elasticsearch-based
— Evaluating vector search and hybrid retrieval approaches for multilingual legal text
— Coordinating with our backend engineers (Python, PostgreSQL) to maintain API compatibility during any migration
— Documenting infrastructure changes clearly enough that the team can maintain them without you in the room

Required background:
— Strong hands-on experience with Elasticsearch or an equivalent large-scale search system
— Familiarity with vector databases or semantic search pipelines is a significant advantage
— Experience planning zero-downtime or near-zero-downtime migrations
— Comfort working on a team of two engineers where you will need to make calls independently

Nice to have:
— Experience with on-premises Kubernetes deployments
— Any background in legal or document-heavy domains

This role is based at NTP Novi Sad. Some remote work is possible after the first three months.

Apply with a CV to posao@pravnipilot.rs and mention 'DB Engineer' in the subject line.

title: O nama i našim uslugama – Polje Senzor d.o.o.
text:
Polje Senzor je mali tim iz Novog Sada koji pravi hardver za praćenje uslova u voćnjacima. Počeli smo 2021. godine sa jednom jasnom idejom: voćar treba da zna šta se dešava na njegovoj parceli u svakom trenutku, a ne da nagađa na osnovu podataka sa obližnje meteorološke stanice koja može biti udaljena i dvadeset kilometara.

Naša PS-Orchard stanica postavlja se direktno između redova voća. Meri temperaturu vazduha, vlažnost lista i količinu padavina, a podatke šalje bežično preko LoRaWAN mreže svakih petnaest minuta. Voćar prati sve na mobilnoj aplikaciji ili veb portalu, a kada naš algoritam detektuje rizik od mraza, stižu mu obaveštenja na telefon.

Osim stanice, nudimo i PS-Gateway mini – mali LoRaWAN gateway za gazdinstva koja se nalaze van dometa postojeće mreže. Montaža traje manje od dva sata i ne zahteva nikakvo posebno znanje.

Svi naši uređaji prolaze trodnevni test pre isporuke. Podršku korisnicima pruža Milena Savić, koja je prethodno radila na terenu kao agro-savetnik, pa razume šta voćarima zaista treba.

Trenutno sarađujemo sa gazdinstvima od Subotice do Čačka. Naši korisnici uglavnom imaju između pet i pedeset hektara i sami upravljaju zaštitom useva. Cene naših uređaja i planova počinju od razumnog iznosa za porodično gazdinstvo – verujemo da precizni podaci ne treba da budu privilegija samo velikih proizvođača.

Ako imate pitanja ili želite da dogovorite demonstraciju na vašoj parceli, pišite nam na info@poljesenzor.rs.

title: Tražimo: Inženjer firmware-a (STM32, niská spotřeba) – puno radno vreme
text:

Šta ćeš raditi:

- Raditi na smanjenju potrošnje energije uređaja, posebno u zimskim uslovima

- Iskustvo sa merenjem i profilisanjem potrošnje struje – ovo nam je stvarno bitno
- Sposobnost da čitaš i razumeš datasheet-ove senzora i modula

Šta ne tražimo:

- Pet godina radnog iskustva ako si dobar i pokazao to

Nudimo:

- Fleksibilno radno vreme uz dogovor
- Platu između 1.400 i 1.800 EUR neto, zavisno od iskustva

Prijave slati na posao@poljesenzor.rs sa naslovom 'Firmware inženjer'. Rok: 5. april 2024.

title: Tražimo: Istraživač / praktičar – računarski vid na edge uređajima (pola radnog vremena ili projekat)
text:
Imamo konkretan problem i tražimo nekoga ko može da pomogne da ga rešimo. Ne tražimo nužno osobu sa punim radnim vremenom – otvoreni smo za angažman na projektu, istraživačku saradnju ili savetodavnu ulogu.

Problematika:
Hoćemo da kamera na feromonskoj klopki u voćnjaku automatski prebrojava ulovljene insekte sa lepljive podloge. Kamera mora da radi na bateriju, prenos podataka ide preko LoRaWAN mreže sa ograničenim propusnim opsegom, a obrada slike mora biti ili lokalna (na malom mikrokontroleru ili namenskom čipu) ili veoma kompresovana pre slanja.

Imamo:
- Prototip napajanja koji funkcioniše
- Oko 200 fotografija lepljivih podloga sa terena
- Iskustvo u integraciji hardvera
- Što nemamo: iskustvo sa modelima za detekciju objekata, kvantizacijom modela, TensorFlow Lite ili sličnim alatima

Šta bi ti radio/la:
- Procenio/la izvodljivost lokalne obrade nasuprot cloud obradi
- Pomogao/la u izboru i eventualnoj obuci malog modela za detekciju insekata
- Sarađivao/la sa našim firmware inženjerom na integraciji

Ako te ovo zanima, napiši nam na razvoj@poljesenzor.rs. Nemoj slati generičku prijavu – napiši šta si konkretno radio/la sa edge AI ili obradom slike na uređajima sa ograničenim resursima.

title: Gazdinstvo Nikolić iz Bačke Palanke prošlo kroz prolećni mraz bez štete zahvaljujući ranom upozorenju
text:
U noći između 8. i 9. aprila 2024. godine temperature u pojasu između Bačke Palanke i Novog Sada pale su ispod nule u ranim jutarnjim satima. Za mnoge voćare to je bila neprijatna iznenađenja – standardne vremenske prognoze nisu predvidele lokalni mraz na ovom terenu.

Obradovalo nas je kad smo ujutru dobili poruku od Jovana Nikolića, vlasnika jabučnjaka od dvanaest hektara u okolini Bačke Palanke, koji koristi naše PS-Orchard stanice od prošle jeseni. Jovan nam je napisao: 'Dobio sam poruku u 2:47 ujutru. Ustao sam, upalio sistem za navodnjavanje kao zaštitu od mraza i vratio se u krevet. Komšija bez sistema je ujutru imao problem sa cvetovima.'

Njegove stanice su izmerile pad temperature na -1,8°C u zoni krošnje, što je dovoljno da ošteti cvetove jabuke u fazi punog cvetanja. Naš algoritam je poslao upozorenje sedam minuta nakon što je temperatura prešla kritičnu granicu.

Ovo je za nas važna potvrda da sistem radi kako treba u realnim uslovima. Nismo uvek savršeni – imali smo i slučajeva lažnih uzbuna tokom zime zbog kondenzacije na senzoru vlažnosti lista, što aktivno radimo na poboljšanju. Ali ova noć nam je pokazala da osnovna namena sistema funkcioniše.

Jovan Nikolić je pristao da učestvuje u testiranju naše buduće kamere za feromonske klopke tokom leta 2024. godine.

title: Bili smo na sajmu AgroNovosad 2024 – utisci i jedan neprijatan razgovor koji nas je naterao da razmišljamo
text:
Prošlog meseca učestvovali smo na sajmu AgroNovosad koji se održava svake godine na Novosadskom sajmu. Imali smo mali štand u paviljonu za agrotehničke inovacije, između prodavca sistema za navodnjavanje i jednog uvoznika gnojiva.

Pozitivno: razgovarali smo sa pedesetak voćara, od kojih su trojica ozbiljno zainteresovana za naše stanice. Marija Petrović iz Fruške gore rekla nam je da je čula za nas od svog suseda i da je godinama čekala nešto ovako. To je lepo čuti.

Manje pozitivno, ali korisno: jedan iskusniji voćar iz Topole, koji je godinama bavio jabučarstvom, postavio nam je direktno pitanje – koliko dugo traju baterije zimi? Kad smo mu odgovorili iskreno, rekao je da to za njega predstavlja problem jer je njegova parcela udaljena četiri kilometra od puta i ne želi da ide tamo po snegu samo da bi zamenio baterije. Razgovor nas je podsetio da ovo nije samo tehnički problem – za nekog ko ima parcelu na teškom terenu, loša baterija zimi znači da sistem prosto nije upotrebljiv.

Odneli smo kući i kontakte triju potencijalnih novih korisnika i jednu listu pitanja na koja još uvek nemamo dobre odgovore. To smatramo korisnim sajmom.

Sledeće godine planiramo da imamo prototip kamere za feromonske klopke koji bismo mogli da pokažemo uživo.

title: Otvoreni dan u NTP Novi Sad – Polje Senzor pokazuje PS-Orchard stanicu uživo
text:
Naučno-tehnološki park Novi Sad organizuje otvoreni dan 5. juna 2024. godine, a Polje Senzor će biti među izlagačima.

Dođite da vidite kako izgleda naša PS-Orchard stanica izbliza. Imaćemo demo postavku sa živim prenosom podataka sa senzora koji će biti montiran u malom testu ispred zgrade NTP-a tokom celog dana. Moći ćete da pratite merenja temperature, vlažnosti i simulaciju upozorenja na fraz u realnom vremenu kroz našu mobilnu aplikaciju.

Naš hardverski inženjer Bojan Đurić biće tu tokom celog prepodneva i može da odgovori na tehnička pitanja o tome kako stanica funkcioniše iznutra – od senzorskog sklopa do LoRaWAN prenosa i cloud-a.

Ako ste voćar koji razmišlja o sistemu za praćenje mikroklime, student koji radi na srodnoj temi, ili jednostavno neko ko je radoznao kako funkcioniše bežična senzorska mreža – dobrodošli ste.

Otvoreni dan traje od 10 do 17 časova. Ulaz je slobodan. Naš štand je u prizemlju, odmah pored recepcije.

Ako planirate da dođete i imate konkretno pitanje unapred, možete nam pisati na info@poljesenzor.rs – pokušaćemo da pripremimo odgovor ili pravi materijal za vas.

title: Tamara Vukić se priključuje timu kao specijalist za izveštavanje
text:
Od septembra 2023. godine Tamara Vukić radi kao peti stalni član tima Analitika Petrović. Tamara dolazi sa iskustvom u finansijskom izveštavanju i radu sa Excel i Metabase alatima, a pre dolaska kod nas radila je u računovodstvenoj firmi u Zrenjaninu.

Njena uloga u timu je preuzimanje izveštajnih zadataka koji ne zahtevaju programiranje — prilagođavanje postojećih izveštajnih šablona, komunikacija sa klijentima oko zahteva za izveštajima, i dokumentovanje sistema koje isporučujemo.

Ovim zapošljavanjem rešili smo deo problema koji smo imali tokom 2023. godine: previše izveštajnih zadataka padalo je na Milicu, koja treba da se fokusira na razvojne zadatke. Sada je podela posla jasnija.

Dobrodošla, Tamara.

title: Završili smo implementaciju sistema za praćenje senzora u Agrozaštita Dunav d.o.o.
text:
U novembru 2023. godine završili smo projekat koji smo s ponosom pratili od prvog sastanka — implementaciju sistema za praćenje senzorskih podataka u skladišnim silosima preduzeća Agrozaštita Dunav d.o.o. iz okoline Zrenjanina.

Agrozaštita Dunav prerađuje i skladišti voće i povrće i imala je problem koji mnoge firme u ovoj branši prepoznaju: senzori su godinama prikupljali podatke o temperaturi, vlažnosti i CO₂, ali te podatke niko nije sistematski čitao. Podaci su bili u nekoliko različitih formata, deo na lokalnim računarima, deo na eksternom disku koji niko nije pregledao od 2021. Naš zadatak bio je da sve to spojimo, očistimo i stavimo u upotrebu.

Instalirali smo TimescaleDB instancu na njihov server, napisali skripte za automatsko unošenje novih merenja i podesili Grafana kontrolnu tablu dostupnu svim tehnolozima iz interne mreže. Mesečni izveštaj koji je ranije zahtevao dva dana ručnog rada sada se generiše automatski.

Na projektu su radili Milica Petrović i Nenad Brkić. Hvala timu Agrozaštita Dunav na strpljenju tokom testiranja — imali smo nekoliko iteracija pre nego što je sve leglo na mesto.

Ovaj projekat za nas nije bio samo tehnički zadatak. Pokazao nam je gde su granice naše sadašnje infrastrukture i šta treba da unapredimo u narednom periodu.

title: O nama i uslugama — Analitika Petrović
text:
Analitika Petrović je porodična firma iz Zrenjanina koja se bavi analitikom podataka i poslovnim izveštavanjem od 1997. godine. Osnivač Dragan Petrović počeo je sa radom sa lokalnim prerađivačima hrane koji su imali pune fascikle podataka, ali nisu imali alat da ih protumače. Od tada smo izgradili sistem rada koji polazi od konkretnog pitanja klijenta — šta zapravo treba da znate? — i odatle idemo unazad do podataka.

Naše usluge obuhvataju:

- Projektovanje i izradu izveštajnih sistema prilagođenih industriji klijenta
- Integraciju podataka iz senzora, mernih uređaja, ERP i računovodstvenih sistema
- Razvoj jednostavnih modela za praćenje i predviđanje procesa
- Vizualizaciju podataka putem Grafana i Metabase kontrolnih tabla dostupnih na intranetu klijenta
- Obuku osoblja za svakodnevni rad sa izveštajnim alatima

Svi naši sistemi rade na infrastrukturi klijenta, bez obaveznog oslanjanja na eksterne cloud servise. Razumemo da mnogi naši klijenti imaju ograničenja u pogledu bezbednosti podataka, troškova i internet konekcije — i projektujemo rešenja koja rade u tim uslovima.

Tim čine Dragan Petrović, Milica Petrović, Jovanka Stanić (analitičar podataka), Nenad Brkić (sistem administrator) i Tamara Vukić (izveštavanje i dokumentacija). Svih pet nas radi iz Zrenjanina.

Ako imate podatke koje ne znate kako da iskoristite, ili izveštaje koji oduzimaju previše vremena, slobodno nas kontaktirajte.

title: Zašto naši izveštaji rade bez interneta — i zašto to ne menjamo
text:
Česta reakcija kada predstavimo naše rešenje novim klijentima je pitanje: zašto ne koristite cloud? Pitanje je razumno, pa ćemo pokušati da odgovorimo iskreno.

Većina naših klijenata su industrijska preduzeća u Vojvodini sa stabilnom ali ne brzom internet konekcijom, sa IT odeljenjima koja imaju dva do tri čoveka i sa politikama bezbednosti podataka koje zabranjuju ili komplikuju slanje operativnih podataka izvan lokalne mreže. Neki imaju i ugovornu obavezu da podaci o procesu ostanu na lokaciji. U tom kontekstu, cloud rešenje nije nemoguće, ali nosi troškove i birokratske prepreke koje mali i srednji prerađivači teško opravdavaju.

Mi projektujemo sisteme koji rade na serverima koje klijent već ima ili koji koštaju koliko jedan rabljeni server — TimescaleDB na Linuxu, Grafana za vizualizaciju, Metabase za izveštavanje. Sve otvorenog koda, sve što se može održavati bez godišnje pretplate.

Postoje granice ovog pristupa. Skalabilnost nije beskonačna, i mi to znamo bolje od bilo koga — upravo se suočavamo sa tim izazovom kod jednog od naših klijenata čija baza raste brže nego što smo planirali. Ali rešenje tog problema ne znači automatski 'idi u cloud'. Znači pametnije upravljanje podacima na raspoloživom hardveru.

Pišemo ovo jer mislimo da ima vrednosti u pristupu koji polazi od realnih uslova klijenta, a ne od pretpostavke da svako može i želi da plati mesečnu pretplatu za infrastrukturu. Ako imate slično iskustvo ili drugačije mišljenje, slobodno nas kontaktirajte.

title: Tražimo: Python developer za analitiku podataka (honorarno ili puno radno vreme)
text:
Analitika Petrović traži programera koji može da se priključi timu u Zrenjaninu ili da radi kao podizvođač u narednih nekoliko meseci. Radi se o konkretnom poslu na aktivnim projektima — nije u pitanju probni period ni teorijsko razmatranje.

Šta radimo: pravimo izveštajne sisteme i jednostavne prediktivne alate za klijente u prehrambenoj industriji, pivarstvu i komunalnim uslugama. Infrastruktura nam je on-premise, uglavnom Linux serveri, i koristimo TimescaleDB, Grafana, Metabase i Python.

Šta vam je potrebno:
- Solidno poznavanje Pythona, pre svega pandas i scikit-learn
- Iskustvo sa SQL bazama podataka, a TimescaleDB ili PostgreSQL su prednost
- Sposobnost da preuzmete deo projekta bez dugog uvođenja
- Nije nam potrebno iskustvo sa cloud platformama — ovde se radi na lokalnoj infrastrukturi

Šta nudimo:
- Konkretan posao sa jasnim zadacima i rokovima
- Tri aktivna projekta u toku: izveštajni modul za komunalno preduzeće, prediktivna kontrolna tabla za pivaru, i početna integracija podataka za prerađivača šećerne repe
- Fleksibilnost u pogledu mesta rada — možete raditi i van Zrenjanina ako ste dostupni za redovnu komunikaciju
- Dogovorena naknada prema obimu posla

Prijave slati na kontakt adresu navedenu na sajtu. Prednost imaju kandidati koji mogu da počnu u roku od dve nedelje.

title: Analitika Petrović na Vojvođanskom sajmu prehrambene industrije 2024
text:
Ovog aprila prvi put ćemo imati štand na Vojvođanskom sajmu prehrambene industrije koji se održava u Novom Sadu. Odlučili smo se na ovaj korak jer značajan deo naše klijentele dolazi upravo iz prehrambene i prerađivačke industrije i vidimo prostor da upoznamo firme sa kojima do sada nismo imali kontakt.

Na štandu ćemo pokazati dve stvari:

Prvo, primer kontrolne table za praćenje senzorskih podataka u skladišnim uslovima — anonimizovana verzija sistema koji koristimo kod postojećeg klijenta. Posetioci mogu da vide kako izgleda praćenje temperature i vlažnosti u realnom vremenu, kako se postavljaju alarmi i kako izgleda automatski mesečni izveštaj.

Drugo, demo prediktivnog modela za praćenje fermentacijskih procesa. Model prikazuje krivulju fermentacije i procenjeno vreme završetka na osnovu trenutnih merenja. Radi se o verziji u razvoju — ne skrivamo da ovaj deo našeg rada još uvek unapređujemo.

Sajam se održava od 18. do 20. aprila. Naš štand biće u hali B. Dragan i Jovanka Stanić biće prisutni sva tri dana; Milica će biti prisutna prvog dana pre podne.

Ako ste zainteresovani za razgovor o konkretnom problemu koji imate sa podacima u vašoj firmi, slobodno zakažite kratki sastanak unapred putem kontakt forme na sajtu — vreme je ograničeno.

title: Contract Manufacturing Services — Farmavita d.o.o.
text:
Farmavita d.o.o. offers contract manufacturing for solid-dose pharmaceutical products and dietary supplements from its GMP-certified site in Novi Sad, Serbia. We have been operating under continuous GMP certification since 2001, and our facility has passed inspections by the Medicines and Medical Devices Agency of Serbia as well as audits conducted by several EU-based clients.

Our core services cover the full production chain for tablets and capsules: formulation development support, wet and dry granulation, film coating, capsule filling, blister and bottle packaging, and batch release testing. We operate two tablet compression lines, one pan coater, one fluid-bed processor, and two capsule filling lines. Our analytical laboratory handles dissolution testing, HPLC assay, uniformity of dosage units, and standard stability studies under ICH conditions.

We work primarily as a silent manufacturer for pharmacy chains, wholesale distributors, and supplement brands who need a reliable production partner without the capital cost of running their own facility. Clients provide the formulation and artwork; we provide the documentation, the manufacturing, and the QC sign-off. Where clients need formulation help, our team can support development within certain technology platforms.

All batches are managed in SAP with full electronic batch records. We ship throughout Serbia and across the Western Balkans, and we are currently expanding our client base in Slovenia and Croatia.

If you are looking for a contract manufacturer with a straightforward audit history, competitive lead times, and people who return calls, we are worth talking to. Contact our business development contact, Ana Vuković, at business@farmavita.rs to request a facility overview and capability statement.

title: Farmavita Renews Long-Term Supply Agreement with Apotek Centrala
text:
Farmavita d.o.o. has renewed its supply agreement with Apotek Centrala, one of the larger pharmacy chains operating across Serbia and Bosnia and Herzegovina, for a further three-year term. The agreement covers eight SKUs manufactured at our Novi Sad facility, including film-coated vitamin D3 and B-complex tablets, magnesium supplement capsules, and two OTC analgesic lines.

The renewal follows an audit of our facility conducted by Apotek Centrala's quality team in November 2023, which we passed without any major findings. One observation regarding batch record archiving was addressed through a procedure update in December.

Jelena Marković, Director of Farmavita, commented: "We have been supplying Apotek Centrala for eleven years. Renewing for another three years is straightforward confirmation that consistent quality and on-time delivery matter more to a long-term client than any marketing claim. We intend to keep it that way."

Apotek Centrala's procurement manager, Tamara Ilić, noted that manufacturing reliability and documentation quality were the primary factors in the renewal decision.

The renewed agreement includes a provision for Farmavita to qualify two additional SKUs — a sustained-release magnesium formulation and a combination zinc and vitamin C tablet — for inclusion in the Apotek Centrala private-label range by Q2 2025. Development work on those products is expected to begin in the second quarter of this year.

Farmavita currently supplies products to six retail and wholesale clients across the Western Balkans region.

title: Process Development Pharmacist — Solid Dose Forms
text:
Farmavita d.o.o. is looking for a pharmacist or pharmaceutical technologist to join our formulation and process development group in Novi Sad.

The role sits within a team of five and covers early-stage formulation work, scale-up support, and in-process troubleshooting for our tablet and capsule lines. Day-to-day work includes designing and running small-scale batches in our development lab, setting up dissolution methods on our USP II apparatus, writing development reports for batch records and technology transfer packages, and working alongside production staff when a new product moves to full scale.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked with controlled-release formulation — polymer matrix systems, membrane-coated pellets, or similar. We have an immediate need in that area and most of our current team's experience is in immediate-release forms. Familiarity with HPMC, ethylcellulose, or Eudragit grades and their dissolution behaviour would be a genuine advantage.

Day-to-day tools include a Distek dissolution system with automated sampling, Empower 3 for data handling, and standard wet granulation and capsule filling equipment. You would be expected to keep development documentation in our SAP system and follow our SOPs for change control and deviation reporting.

We are not offering a research position. This is a manufacturing-environment role with practical output expectations. The team is small, the equipment time is real, and the decisions you make will show up in production batches within weeks.

Qualifications: degree in pharmacy, pharmaceutical technology, or chemistry; at least two years in a GMP manufacturing or development environment; working knowledge of ICH Q8 development documentation. Serbian language is required for day-to-day communication on the production floor.

Salary: negotiable based on experience. Send CV and a short cover note to hr@farmavita.rs.

title: What We Learned from Two Years of Coating Batch Data
text:
Our pan coater has been running since 2009. Over the past two years, following a batch documentation improvement project, we have been capturing inlet air temperature, outlet temperature, spray rate, atomisation pressure, and pan speed at fifteen-minute intervals for every coating run. That gives us a reasonably detailed process log for around 2,500 batches.

We started this logging exercise because our weight-variation failure rate on coated tablets was sitting at around four percent — higher than it should be for a process we have been running for fifteen years. The logic was straightforward: if we have better data, we can find the problem.

Two years later, we have better data and we still cannot clearly identify the problem. We have looked at each parameter individually. We know our inlet temperature drifts more in winter when the building HVAC is fighting colder outside air, and we know our failure rate is slightly higher in November through February. But the correlation is not clean enough to act on, and when we tightened the inlet temperature control range last spring, the effect was temporary.

What we think is happening is that the failure is driven by a combination of parameters interacting, not any single one. When spray rate and pan speed are both at the lower end of their ranges while inlet temperature is high, something happens to film build-up uniformity that individual control charts do not catch. But we do not have the analytical tools in-house to confirm that, and designing a proper experiment around three or four variables simultaneously is not something our team has done before.

We are writing this partly to document where we are and partly because we are actively looking for someone who works with this kind of process data to help us move forward. If that sounds like something you do, our contact details are on the website.

title: IT / OT Integration Specialist (Part-Time Contract)
text:
Farmavita d.o.o. is seeking an IT or automation specialist for a part-time contract engagement to support a serialisation integration project at our Novi Sad facility.

Background: We are required to implement EU Falsified Medicines Directive-compliant serialisation on our packaging lines before the end of 2024. We have Zebra ZT620 label printers and a Cognex camera verification unit already installed and tested at the hardware level. What we need is a working data integration between that hardware layer and our SAP ECC 6.0 system, and from there to the EU Hub repository managed by NMVS Serbia.

The engagement is not a full systems-integration project — we are looking for someone who can help us design and implement a practical middleware or connector approach that our existing one-person IT team can maintain after go-live. We want to avoid a large-scale SAP customisation if there is a lighter path that meets the regulatory requirement.

Ideal background: experience with SAP ECC integration (IDocs, RFC, or REST API approaches), familiarity with GS1 standards and EPCIS event formats, and ideally some prior exposure to track-and-trace or serialisation projects in a regulated industry. Pharmaceutical industry experience is helpful but not required — the compliance logic is well-documented and we can brief the right person.

Engagement: approximately 20–30 hours per week for four to six months, on-site in Novi Sad at least two days per week. Budget is constrained; we are looking for a practical solution, not a premium consultancy rate.

Contact Miloš Đurić, IT Manager, at m.djuric@farmavita.rs with a brief description of relevant experience.

title: Farmavita at PharmConnect Balkans 2024 — Booth 34, Hall B
text:
